title: Rippers Unmasked — Classes & Skills
description: The Rippers Unmasked class corpus as native Foundry Item packs the GM drags onto Project FU sheets: type:class Items for every Rippers class, their class skills as UUID-linked type:skill Items, and heroic skills as type:heroic Items with their requirements listed. Ships a browsable JournalEntry Player Reference pack (all 68 classes + shared-subsystem notes as readable prose). Original campaign content, layered on Project FU. A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

rippers-compendium.note: v0.4.1: FIX — the v0.4.0 player-reference LevelDB shipped inconsistent (CURRENT/MANIFEST pointed at a stale .ldb lineage from in-place recompiles), so Foundry v13 failed to open it ("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading packData)"). tools/pack.mjs now clears each target pack dir before compiling, so every pack ships a clean single-manifest LevelDB. Content unchanged. --- Items validate against Project FU's class/skill/heroic DataModels (packs system:projectfu). The player-reference JournalEntry pack renders the verbatim player binder — 68 classes + shared-subsystem notes — as browsable in-world prose (folders: Innate Only / Guise / Appendix), built from lodge-docs/COMPENDIUM-player-reference.md by tools/build-journals.mjs; formatting-only, no rules edits (editorial ✎/⚠/⛔ glyph marks stripped, all prose incl. house rulings kept). v0.4.0 RECONCILED the appendix to Compendium2.pdf Part V (Austin's authority): 8 reference notes (Heroics · Arcana Registry · Arcanum · Keystones · Torments · Personal Vehicle · NPC Spells [See-You-Later/Unexpected-Ally folded in] · Pressure and Stagger [new, extracted from the PDF p180–183]). The PDF's class bodies + all 271 numbered SL caps verify identical to the .md (the .md is the PDF's own upstream source), so names/bodies/caps are unchanged. No FU content is redistributed; no automation code.
